disclaimer: Educational information only — not a diagnosis or prescription. Homeopathic product notes describe traditional use and product labelling; they are not a claim that homeopathy cures disease. Always seek advice from a qualified clinician for personal medical decisions.

systems.name: Cardiovascular
systems.description: Heart and blood vessels that circulate blood.

systems.name: Respiratory
systems.description: Lungs and airways for gas exchange.

systems.name: Digestive
systems.description: Organs that break down food and absorb nutrients.

systems.name: Nervous
systems.description: Brain, spinal cord and peripheral nerves.

systems.name: Musculoskeletal
systems.description: Bones, joints, muscles and connective tissue.

systems.name: Skin & Sensory
systems.description: Skin, eyes, ears and related structures.

systems.name: Lymphatic & Immune
systems.description: Lymph nodes, spleen and immune tissues.

organs.name: Brain
organs.summary: Central organ of the nervous system that coordinates thought, movement and vital functions.
organs.function: Processes sensory input, controls voluntary and involuntary actions, and supports cognition, emotion and memory.
organs.description: The brain sits within the skull and connects to the spinal cord. Major regions include the cerebrum, cerebellum and brainstem.

organs.name: Thyroid
organs.summary: Butterfly-shaped gland in the neck that regulates metabolism through hormones.
organs.function: Produces thyroxine (T4) and triiodothyronine (T3), influencing energy use, temperature and growth.
organs.description: Located at the front of the neck below the Adam's apple. Disorders may present with weight, mood or heart-rate changes.

organs.name: Heart
organs.summary: Muscular pump that circulates blood through the body.
organs.function: Maintains blood flow delivering oxygen and nutrients and removing waste.
organs.description: Located in the chest slightly left of centre. Four chambers and valves coordinate each heartbeat.

organs.name: Lungs
organs.summary: Paired organs of gas exchange that oxygenate blood.
organs.function: Move oxygen into the bloodstream and remove carbon dioxide.
organs.description: Occupy most of the chest cavity on either side of the heart, connected to airways and the diaphragm.

organs.name: Liver
organs.summary: Largest internal organ; processes nutrients, toxins and produces bile.
organs.function: Metabolises nutrients, detoxifies substances, stores glycogen and synthesises proteins.
organs.description: Located mainly in the upper right abdomen under the ribcage.

organs.name: Stomach
organs.summary: Muscular sac that begins chemical digestion of food.
organs.function: Mixes food with acid and enzymes and regulates emptying into the intestine.
organs.description: Lies in the upper abdomen, mostly left of midline.

organs.name: Intestines
organs.summary: Small and large bowel for nutrient absorption and waste formation.
organs.function: Absorb nutrients and water; host microbiome activity; form stool.
organs.description: Fill much of the abdominal cavity from stomach outlet to rectum.

organs.name: Kidneys
organs.summary: Paired organs that filter blood and regulate fluid and electrolytes.
organs.function: Remove waste as urine, balance salts and blood pressure, and support vitamin D activation.
organs.description: Retroperitoneal organs on either side of the spine at mid-back level.

organs.name: Bladder
organs.summary: Muscular reservoir that stores urine before voiding.
organs.function: Stores urine and coordinates emptying with urethral sphincters.
organs.description: Pelvic organ behind the pubic bone.

organs.name: Pancreas
organs.summary: Gland with digestive enzymes and blood-sugar hormones.
organs.function: Releases enzymes into the intestine and insulin/glucagon into blood.
organs.description: Lies across the upper abdomen behind the stomach.

organs.name: Spleen
organs.summary: Lymphoid organ that filters blood and supports immune responses.
organs.function: Removes aged blood cells and helps fight certain infections.
organs.description: Soft organ in the upper left abdomen under the ribcage.

organs.name: Spine
organs.summary: Column of vertebrae protecting the spinal cord and supporting posture.
organs.function: Provides structural support, flexibility and a protected path for nerves.
organs.description: Runs from the skull to the pelvis along the back midline.

organs.name: Joints
organs.function: Enable motion while distributing load across cartilage and ligaments.
organs.description: Major joints include shoulders, elbows, hips, knees and ankles.

organs.name: Muscles
organs.summary: Contractile tissue that powers movement and posture.
organs.function: Generate force, stabilise joints and support metabolism.
organs.description: Skeletal muscles attach via tendons across the body.

organs.name: Eyes
organs.function: Focus light onto the retina and send signals via the optic nerve.
organs.description: Protected by eyelids, tears and orbital bones.

organs.name: Skin
organs.summary: Largest organ; barrier, sensory and temperature regulator.
organs.function: Protects against injury and microbes, senses touch and helps thermoregulate.
organs.description: Covers the entire body surface with epidermis, dermis and hypodermis layers.

organs.name: Male reproductive system
organs.summary: Testes, prostate and related structures for hormone and sperm production.
organs.function: Produces sperm and testosterone; supports sexual and reproductive function.
organs.description: Includes testes, epididymis, vas deferens, prostate and penis.

organs.name: Female reproductive system
organs.summary: Ovaries, uterus and related structures supporting hormones, fertility and pregnancy.
organs.function: Produces eggs and hormones; supports menstruation, conception and pregnancy.
organs.description: Includes ovaries, fallopian tubes, uterus, cervix and vagina.

diseases.name: Migraine
diseases.summary: Recurrent headache disorder often with sensory sensitivity.

diseases.name: Stroke risk awareness
diseases.summary: Emergency brain blood-flow interruption; know FAST signs.

diseases.name: Hypothyroidism (overview)
diseases.summary: Underactive thyroid with low hormone output.

diseases.name: Angina (overview)
diseases.summary: Chest discomfort from reduced heart blood flow.

diseases.name: COPD awareness
diseases.summary: Progressive airflow limitation often linked to smoking.

diseases.name: Hepatitis awareness
diseases.summary: Liver inflammation from viruses or other causes.

diseases.name: Peptic ulcer (overview)
diseases.summary: Break in stomach or duodenal lining.

diseases.name: IBS (overview)
diseases.summary: Functional bowel disorder with pain and stool change.

diseases.name: Pancreatitis awareness
diseases.summary: Inflammation of the pancreas — can be acute emergency.

diseases.name: Back pain (overview)
diseases.summary: Common musculoskeletal symptom with many causes.

diseases.name: Disc problem awareness
diseases.summary: Disc degeneration or herniation affecting nerves.

diseases.name: Sprain (overview)
diseases.summary: Ligament injury from stretch or tear.

diseases.name: Dry eye (overview)
diseases.summary: Inadequate tear film quality or quantity.

diseases.name: Acne (overview)
diseases.summary: Pilosebaceous unit disorder common in adolescence.

diseases.name: BPH (overview)
diseases.summary: Benign prostate enlargement affecting urine flow.

diseases.name: PCOS (overview)
diseases.summary: Hormonal condition with cycle and metabolic features.

mental_conditions.name: Anxiety
mental_conditions.summary: Excessive worry or fear that interferes with daily life.

mental_conditions.name: Depression
mental_conditions.summary: Persistent low mood and loss of interest lasting weeks or more.

mental_conditions.name: Stress
mental_conditions.summary: Body and mind response to demands that can become harmful when chronic.

mental_conditions.name: OCD
mental_conditions.summary: Obsessive thoughts and compulsive behaviours aimed at reducing distress.

mental_conditions.name: Panic disorders
mental_conditions.summary: Recurrent panic attacks with intense physical fear symptoms.
support: Emergency care for first severe episode

mental_conditions.name: Sleep disorders
mental_conditions.summary: Problems initiating, maintaining or experiencing restorative sleep.

mental_conditions.name: ADHD
mental_conditions.summary: Neurodevelopmental pattern of inattention and/or hyperactivity-impulsivity.

mental_conditions.name: Trauma-related conditions
mental_conditions.summary: Distress following traumatic events, including PTSD spectrum.

homeopathy_products.name: Nux vomica
homeopathy_products.description: Widely stocked homeopathic preparation traditionally associated with digestive irritability and stress-related patterns.
homeopathy_products.traditional_claims: Traditionally used in homeopathy for digestive upset and overindulgence-related complaints.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: High-quality clinical evidence that homeopathy treats specific diseases is lacking. Any benefit is unproven beyond placebo for most indications.
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: Not a substitute for emergency or specialist care. Follow labelled dose. Keep away from children.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: Discuss with a clinician if pregnant, breastfeeding, or on critical medicines. Seek urgent care for severe abdominal pain, vomiting blood, or neurological red flags.

homeopathy_products.name: Gelsemium
homeopathy_products.description: Homeopathic preparation traditionally linked with anticipatory anxiety and flu-like weakness patterns.
homeopathy_products.traditional_claims: Traditionally used for trembling anxiety and heaviness.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: No robust evidence that it cures anxiety disorders or infections.
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: Educational listing only. Do not delay evidence-based mental health care.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: Not for severe psychiatric crisis — seek emergency help if unsafe.

homeopathy_products.name: Thyroidinum
homeopathy_products.description: Homeopathic thyroid preparation found in some catalogues.
homeopathy_products.traditional_claims: Traditionally discussed in homeopathy for thyroid-related symptom pictures.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: Does not replace thyroid hormone testing or prescribed thyroxine/antithyroid therapy.
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: Never stop prescribed thyroid medicine without endocrinology advice.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: Known thyroid disease requires conventional monitoring.

homeopathy_products.name: Crataegus
homeopathy_products.description: Hawthorn preparation used in herbal and homeopathic traditions for heart-related symptom pictures.
homeopathy_products.traditional_claims: Traditional cardiac tonic associations in naturopathic literature.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: Not a proven treatment for coronary disease; urgent cardiac symptoms need emergency care.
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: Chest pain, fainting or severe breathlessness = emergency services.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: May interact with cardiac medicines — ask a pharmacist/clinician.

homeopathy_products.name: Digitalis
homeopathy_products.description: Homeopathic digitalis preparation; distinct from prescription digoxin.
homeopathy_products.traditional_claims: Historically associated with heart symptom pictures in homeopathic materia medica.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: Homeopathic digitalis is not equivalent to monitored digoxin therapy.
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: Do not confuse with prescription digitalis glycosides.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: Heart failure and arrhythmia need cardiology care.

homeopathy_products.name: Antimonium tartaricum
homeopathy_products.description: Traditional homeopathic remedy sometimes discussed for rattling cough pictures.
homeopathy_products.traditional_claims: Traditionally used for loose, rattling cough patterns.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: Not proven to treat pneumonia or COPD; seek medical care for breathing difficulty.
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: Difficulty breathing, blue lips, high fever in children — urgent care.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: Not a substitute for inhalers or oxygen therapy.

homeopathy_products.name: Bryonia
homeopathy_products.description: Homeopathic remedy traditionally linked with dry cough and motion-aggravated pains.
homeopathy_products.traditional_claims: Traditional dry cough / stitching pain pictures.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: Insufficient evidence for disease-specific efficacy.
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: Persistent cough >3 weeks needs clinical review.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: Chest pain with breathlessness needs urgent assessment.

homeopathy_products.name: Carduus marianus
homeopathy_products.description: Milk thistle related preparation appearing in homeopathic and herbal contexts.
homeopathy_products.traditional_claims: Traditionally associated with liver support narratives.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: Does not cure hepatitis or replace hepatology care.
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: Jaundice and severe abdominal pain need medical review.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: Allergy to Asteraceae; check interactions.

homeopathy_products.name: Chelidonium
homeopathy_products.description: Homeopathic preparation traditionally linked with right-sided liver/gallbladder pictures.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: Not a proven treatment for biliary colic or hepatitis.
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: Severe RUQ pain may be surgical emergency.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: Pregnancy caution — clinician advice.

homeopathy_products.name: Robinia
homeopathy_products.description: Traditionally discussed for acidic eructation pictures.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: Unproven for GORD; alarm features need endoscopy pathways.
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: Black stools / vomiting blood = emergency.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: Long-term reflux needs medical evaluation.

homeopathy_products.name: Aloe
homeopathy_products.description: Homeopathic aloe preparation sometimes linked with urgency diarrhoea pictures.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: Not a treatment for IBD or infection.
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: Bloody diarrhoea needs prompt assessment.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: Dehydration risk — medical care if severe.

homeopathy_products.name: Berberis vulgaris
homeopathy_products.description: Traditionally associated with radiating kidney-region pains in materia medica.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: Does not dissolve stones; severe flank pain needs urgent care.
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: Fever with flank pain may be pyelonephritis.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: Not a substitute for urology care.

homeopathy_products.name: Cantharis
homeopathy_products.description: Traditionally linked with burning urinary symptoms.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: UTIs often need culture-guided antibiotics — do not delay.
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: Fever, back pain, pregnancy UTI — urgent care.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: Not for pyelonephritis management alone.

homeopathy_products.name: Syzygium jambolanum
homeopathy_products.description: Appears in some catalogues around glucose-related traditional narratives.
homeopathy_products.traditional_claims: Traditional metabolic symptom associations in homeopathy/herbal lore.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: Does not replace diabetes medicines, insulin or monitoring.
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: Hypo/hyperglycaemia emergencies need medical care.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: Never stop insulin/oral agents without clinician advice.

homeopathy_products.name: Ceanothus
homeopathy_products.description: Traditionally mentioned for spleen-region discomfort pictures.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: Unproven; splenomegaly needs medical diagnosis.
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: Trauma to enlarged spleen can bleed — urgent care.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: Asplenic patients need vaccine protocols.

homeopathy_products.name: Rhus toxicodendron
homeopathy_products.description: Commonly stocked remedy traditionally linked with stiffness improving with motion.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: Not disease-modifying for rheumatoid arthritis.
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: Hot swollen joints need rheumatology pathways.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: Do not delay DMARD therapy when indicated.

homeopathy_products.name: Arnica montana
homeopathy_products.description: Popular homeopathic preparation traditionally used around bruises and sore muscles.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: Evidence for meaningful clinical benefit is limited/mixed; not for open wounds (topical herbal arnica).
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: Serious injury needs medical assessment. Topical herbal arnica ≠ homeopathic pellet.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: Allergy to Asteraceae.

homeopathy_products.name: Euphrasia
homeopathy_products.description: Traditionally associated with eye irritation pictures.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: Not proven for conjunctivitis; red flags need eye care.
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: Vision loss / severe pain = urgent ophthalmology.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: Contact lens related red eye needs professional care.

homeopathy_products.name: Graphites
homeopathy_products.description: Traditionally linked with cracked, oozing skin pictures.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: Does not replace dermatology care for severe eczema.
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: Infected skin needs medical review.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: Steroid/emollient plans should not be abandoned abruptly.

homeopathy_products.name: Sulphur
homeopathy_products.description: Polychrest remedy traditionally linked with burning, itchy skin pictures.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: Unproven disease-specific efficacy.
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: Widespread rash with systemic symptoms needs review.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: Avoid self-treating suspected cellulitis.

homeopathy_products.name: Sabal serrulata
homeopathy_products.description: Saw palmetto related preparation appearing in prostate-support narratives.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: Does not replace urology assessment for retention or cancer pathways.
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: Acute retention / blood in urine — urgent care.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: Discuss with clinician before combining with hormones.

homeopathy_products.name: Sepia
homeopathy_products.description: Traditionally discussed for hormonal and pelvic symptom pictures in women.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: Not a cure for endometriosis or PCOS.
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: Heavy bleeding / severe pelvic pain needs gynaecology review.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: Pregnancy concerns — clinician first.

homeopathy_products.name: Pulsatilla
homeopathy_products.description: Polychrest traditionally linked with changeable mood and hormonal pictures.
homeopathy_products.traditional_claims: Traditional menstrual and mild catarrhal associations.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: Insufficient evidence for disease treatment claims.
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: Educational use only.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: Seek care for abnormal bleeding.

homeopathy_products.name: Arsenicum album
homeopathy_products.description: Traditionally associated with anxiety, restlessness and burning pains in materia medica.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: Not a treatment for clinical anxiety disorders.
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: Mental health crises need evidence-based care.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: Not for suicidal ideation management.

homeopathy_products.name: Aurum metallicum
homeopathy_products.description: Traditionally linked with profound low mood pictures in classical texts.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: Does not treat clinical depression; antidepressants/therapy follow clinical guidelines.
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: If suicidal, contact emergency services / local crisis lines immediately.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: Not a substitute for psychiatric care.

homeopathy_products.name: Ignatia amara
homeopathy_products.description: Traditionally associated with grief and emotional shock pictures.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: Unproven; trauma needs trauma-informed therapy.
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: Persistent depression after loss needs professional support.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: Crisis = emergency help.

homeopathy_products.name: Kali phosphoricum
homeopathy_products.description: Tissue salt traditionally marketed for nervous fatigue.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: Not proven for ADHD or clinical anxiety.
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: Educational listing only.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: Seek assessment for impairing attention/mood symptoms.

homeopathy_products.name: Aconitum napellus
homeopathy_products.description: Traditionally linked with sudden fright and panic-like pictures.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: Not a treatment for panic disorder.
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: First panic attack may need medical rule-out of cardiac causes.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: Emergency symptoms need ER assessment.

homeopathy_products.name: Coffea cruda
homeopathy_products.description: Traditionally associated with overactive mind and sleeplessness.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: Not a substitute for CBT-I or apnoea evaluation.
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: Loud snoring with pauses needs sleep apnoea screening.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: Long-term hypnotic self-medication risks — clinician advice.

homeopathy_products.name: Passiflora
homeopathy_products.description: Passionflower appears in herbal and homeopathic sleep/calm narratives.
homeopathy_products.evidence_status: Evidence limited; not proven for chronic insomnia disorders.
homeopathy_products.safety_warnings: May cause drowsiness — care with driving.
homeopathy_products.contraindications: Check interactions with sedatives.
